task_instruction: Rewrite each affirmative statement as a negative question.
paragraphs: A neighborhood group is preparing a shared garden beside the library. {{red:They can use the sunny corner for vegetables.}} {{mask_1}}? The organizer measures the space before anyone starts digging. {{red:Each gardener must label their own tools.}} {{mask_2}}? The labels help everyone return the tools to the right shed.

On planting day, volunteers check the weather. {{red:They should cover the young seedlings tonight.}} {{mask_3}}? The forecast says the temperature may drop. {{red:The garden beds can hold more compost.}} {{mask_4}}? The group has brought several bags from the community center. {{red:You must wear gloves when handling the compost.}} {{mask_5}}? A volunteer places spare gloves near the gate.

A new gardener asks about the water system. {{red:She can use the rain barrel for the plants.}} {{mask_6}}? The organizer shows her the marked tap. {{red:Visitors must close the tap after watering.}} {{mask_7}}? The garden has limited water during dry weeks. {{red:The volunteers could build another raised bed.}} {{mask_8}}? They first need to check the available space.

In the afternoon, the group plants herbs along the path. {{red:They should leave room for people to walk.}} {{mask_9}}? The organizer has marked a clear path with string. {{red:Everyone must keep the entrance clear.}} {{mask_10}}? A delivery cart needs to pass through the gate. {{red:The children may help plant the small pots.}} {{mask_11}}? An adult stays with them and explains each step.

After planting, the team makes a weekly care schedule. {{red:Each volunteer can choose a day to water.}} {{mask_12}}? The organizer writes every name on the board. {{red:They should check the soil before watering.}} {{mask_13}}? Too much water can harm some plants. {{red:The group will share extra vegetables with the shelter.}} {{mask_14}}? The shelter has asked for fresh produce when it is available.

A few weeks later, the first leaves appear. {{red:The gardeners might need more plant labels.}} {{mask_15}}? Several seedlings look similar. {{red:They can put the labels beside each row.}} {{mask_16}}? The organizer brings a box of weatherproof markers. {{red:Visitors should wait before picking the vegetables.}} {{mask_17}}? The plants need more time to grow.

At the end of the month, the group meets to review the garden. {{red:They must remove weeds from the paths.}} {{mask_18}}? The volunteers bring small hand tools. {{red:The garden may attract more neighbors.}} {{mask_19}}? The library has posted an invitation on its noticeboard. {{red:Everyone should keep the shared space tidy.}} {{mask_20}}? The group agrees to meet again next Saturday.
